text_block_list.name: Child Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yay~! I'm back to the original Iroha!! Sono-chan, wearing clothes so neatly is suffocating!! Tossing them away!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イエ～イ！　
元のイロハに戻ったー！！
ソノちゃん服きれいに着すぎて
窮屈っ！！
ぽいぽいぽーい！！

text_block_list.name: Child Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! It's light and easy to move in~! This feels right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははっ！
軽いし動きやすーいっ！
やっぱこれこれーっ！

text_block_list.name: Adult Sono
text_block_list.text: No, before that, don't just casually undress! It's making me embarrassed...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやその前に気軽に脱ぐな！
こっちが恥ずかしいわ……っ！

text_block_list.name: Adult Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, as always, you show too much skin. Will you ever develop a sense of shame, seriously? Cover up your chest and legs...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく
毎度のことながら肌出し過ぎな。
そろそろ羞恥心湧いてくんないかな
マジで。
胸とか
足とか
隠せ隠せ……！

text_block_list.name: Child Iroha
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm going to play outside!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
お外遊び行こーっと！！

text_block_list.name: Adult Sono
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll have some barley soda here. Pshu~.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ
こっちは麦しゅわいくかな。
プシュッとな。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...The original form is starting to feel weird now...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……元の姿の方が違和感出てきた……
